commit.summary: Spec 35 step 1b: a loose unit's `at` and a fleeing unit's `offset` move off their entries and into the unit store, as the `LOOSE_AT` and `FLEE_OFFSET` columns. A new `FLAGS` column has `LOOSE` and `FLEEING` bits that say whether a unit has each entry. Entries are given and taken away only through the new `SquadEntries`, so the bits always match them. Every reader and writer switched in this PR: no forwarding. Outcomes don't change. The digest rebuilds the entries with `"at"`/`"offset"` from the store, so its bytes are unchanged.
commit.title: feat(formation): loose and fleeing places live in the unit store
